2.body1: Scalable, efficient web solutions using React, Node.js, and modern design tools. From dynamic applications to clean interfaces, your vision drives the build.
2.body2: Docker containerization, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Railway hosting keep deployments smooth and your application stable.
2.body3: Clean code and thoughtful design decisions that solve real problems and work for your users.

4.body1: Every project starts with the user in mind. I prioritize intuitive interfaces that make your users' journey seamless and enjoyable.
4.body2: I develop robust and scalable systems that ensure your applications run smoothly, no matter the load.
4.body3: I prioritize building solutions that are robust, secure and maintainable, ensuring your applications are dependable now and in the future.

giftboxes.title: Fun fact
giftboxes.1: Jon Helge once spent a whole evening hunting a bug that turned out to be a missing semicolon. Biome fights that battle for him now.
giftboxes.2: Certified computer electronics specialist: he can fix your laptop and your layout in the same afternoon.
giftboxes.3: Jon Helge's first line of code printed “Hello, world”. He has been chasing that feeling ever since.
giftboxes.4: Favorite keyboard shortcut? Ctrl+Z, closely followed by git reflog.
giftboxes.5: He earned a bachelor's in web development and an honorary diploma in drinking coffee while Docker builds.
giftboxes.6: GitHub Actions handles his CI/CD, so he can relax during deploys — in theory. He still watches the logs.
giftboxes.7: He hosts on Railway, but his best ideas still run on fresh coffee and Christmas music.
giftboxes.8: Every project starts with a sketch, a coffee, and the words: “this should be simple enough”.
